objective: Frozen computation: every distinct connected arrangement of up to five parity knots of three to five places under the fewest counts; outcome, measured dimension and the chain-birth rule.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 3 of 8 predictions held; 2 of 265 shards pending): of 26,241 distinct arrangements of up to five touching knots, 41.6% stall in round 1, 14.1% close, 7.9% grow one-dimensionally, 36.2% two-dimensionally, 0.14% three-, 0.03% four-dimensionally, 0.03% (rings of five) faster than any power; similar by labelled count. Two-dimensional growth is typical among growing arrangements (about 81% at four and five knots); the chain rule held in 98.7%, with 145 plus-one exceptions.
title: Arrangement census
